It does NOT run the cold/instructions/retrieval/SPIDER arms and therefore provides ZERO evidence for or against the product thesis C-LLM-INHERIT. C-LLM-INHERIT remains HYPOTHESIS regardless of this outcome.' The producer and the independent audit agree: result.json.status=COMPLETE outcome=SUPPORTS with metrics.certificate_overall=PASS, and audit.json.status=PASS with producer_claim_supported=true (the producer ceiling on the CERTIFICATE is supported), but audit.json.claim_ceiling states 'This certificate does NOT establish C-LLM-INHERIT (remains HYPOTHESIS), does not demonstrate real-Web or LLM-inheritance benefit, does not test the four-arm benchmark'. Zero arms executed; model_calls=0, model_tokens=0, browser_actions=0, http_requests=0, and every four-arm scientific metric (task_success_rate, false_accept_rate, cost_per_verified_success) is unmeasured. C-LLM-INHERIT's registry next_gate ('same model/tools/budget; cold vs instructions vs retrieval vs SPIDER', research/claims/registry.json line 10) was not touched: this packet executed zero arms of exactly that comparison. NOT advanced to EXPERIMENTAL/VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE: VALIDATED requires a PASS audit supporting an admissible measurement OF THE CLAIM, and the audit only supports an instrument-establishment measurement. NOT REJECTED/SUPERSEDED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED: nothing was falsified, nothing was measured badly, and the certificate transaction completed validly. The claim's registry status is UNCHANGED at HYPOTHESIS. The genuinely new result is instrument-level, not claim-level: AUDIT independently rebuilt the SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture from prereg.md and re-ran the certificate against the recorded post-repair kernel blob (audit.json validity_findings[0]), so the arm-differentiation prerequisite that parent EXP-PRODUCT-37385633334 identified as structurally impossible is now shown solvable on a synthetic fixture, and the downstream four-arm benchmark is executable and non-degenerate pending a model credential.

Required product action: PRESERVE the committed kernel repair on the branch so the four-arm benchmark can run against it; do NOT merge it as product core, do NOT add product-path residue, and queue the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark as a SEPARATE NEW mandated experiment gated on a programmatic model endpoint credential. reason: The frozen certificate passed all of its checks, and the independent audit confirms the producer's certificate ceiling rather than merely the packet's completion. result.json: status=COMPLETE, outcome=SUPPORTS, certificate_overall=PASS, in_support_executable_rate=1.0, held_out_binding_correct_rate=1.0, out_of_support_refusal_rate=1.0, missing_param_refusal_rate=1.0, wrong_intent_refusal_rate=1.0, treatment_contrast_rate=1.0, degenerate_variant_detected=true, counter_max_relative_error=0.0, and inherited_path_counter_increments declared==observed (retrieval_calls=3, verification_calls=2, repair_attempts=1). audit.json: status=PASS, producer_claim_supported=true, required_fixes=[] (empty), and recomputed_metrics matching the producer field for field. I inspected the raw evidence directly rather than adopting the summaries: raw_certificate/arm_differentiation_certificate.json shows 6/6 held-out cases resolved EXECUTABLE with correct bindings and verify True (itm-0009, epsilon, tok-99, res-z, t9/i9, n-09), 24/24 declared negative cases refused with bound_action=null and a non-empty reason, 6/6 treatment actions differing from the B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED comparator (F1 itm-0009 vs itm-0001; F5 t9/i9 vs t1/i1), the forced NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT variant yielding contrast_rate=0.0 and degenerate_variant_detected=true, and B-LITERAL-KERNEL producing 0/6 EXECUTABLE on the held-out set (the pre-repair literal path exists at confidence 0.5 but resolves only to EXPLORE/UNKNOWN). These checks directly repair the bounded defect parent EXP-PRODUCT-37385633334 found: the earlier gate could certify substrate PRESENT but never that the treatment arm could DIFFER from its comparator; this packet adds a demonstrated-firing arm-differentiation control and shows it fires. Causal attribution is intact: the liveness appears only after the in-scope repair, and the pre-repair literal path produces zero EXECUTABLE. Two independent facts keep this from being read as product evidence. First, the packet's own frozen validity boundary (spec.json.measurement_validity[0]) and the audit's claim_ceiling both say the certificate measures zero evidence for or against C-LLM-INHERIT, which is why the claim status stays HYPOTHESIS and no promotion occurs. Second, the instrument has disclosed narrowness: support inference is anchored to the finite induction values and is narrower than the declared grammar (F2 even over-accepts with ^[a-z]+$), the confidence policy is a fixed 0.9 chosen to clear the unchanged 0.8 threshold, model counters fired only on an explicitly injected synthetic event, and the comparator is not a real LLM arm. I also re-verified, read-only, the environment facts that define the next dependency: OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENCODE_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY and HF_TOKEN are all unset, and playwright, httpx, openai and anthropic all raise ModuleNotFoundError -- so the downstream four-arm benchmark remains genuine-blocked on a provisioned model credential and tolerates no proxy. The workspace matches HEAD 7bd443c7 with only the untracked model_director.json present, so no residue or revert is required. continue=false because the next step is a NEW four-arm experiment requiring a credential and a fresh Global Research Director mandate, neither of which the lane may self-supply.
